<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>No space left on device</span></div>

## Why it happens

Setup asks for at least 10 GB free. On a running system the database stops writing when the disk is full. Common space users are update copies and history kept after a database change, ClickHouse's own logs on older installations, and old Docker images.

## Fix it

- In Platform Manager, remove what you no longer need under **Kept after earlier changes**.
- Empty ClickHouse's own log tables: see [ClickHouse's own logs](/docs/operations/tuning/#clickhouse-s-own-logs).
- Remove old Docker images with `docker image prune`.
- Shorten telemetry retention in the [tenant profile](/docs/user-guide/tenant-profiles/), or add a disk.

## Check that it worked

The **System check** passes, or the database writes again.
